exposure: cefazolin administration in pregnant patients with a documented history of penicillin allergy
outcome: allergic adverse event (IgE-mediated hives, non-IgE-mediated rashes, anaphylaxis)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 179 pregnant patients with a documented penicillin allergy who received cefazolin at a large tertiary care hospital between January 2016 and August 2021.
finding: Cefazolin was safely administered to 97.8% of pregnant patients with a documented penicillin allergy, with no anaphylaxis reported, even among those with a history of penicillin anaphylaxis.
